title: Direct Lookup Table (n-D)
text: Index into n-dimensional table to retrieve element, vector, or 2-D matrix, 3 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Number of table dimensions} sets Number of dimensions of table data; {Make table an input} sets the provide, {Table data} sets the table of output values {Inputs select this object from table} sets the whether output is an element, vector, or 2-D matrix, {Diagnostic for out-of-range input} sets the block action when input is out of range, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Remove protection against out-of-range input in generated code} sets the remove code that checks for out-of-range input, {Table minimum} sets the minimum value table data can have, {Table maximum} sets the maximum value table data can have, {Table data type} sets the data type of table data and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.
